description:
Authenticator to generate 2-step verification codes using your YubiKey

Authenticator to generate 2-step verification codes using your YubiKey
This is a Windows-only release.
- Fix: installing on a system without the Visual C++ Redistributable failed; the runtime is now included.
- Fix: upgrading from 7.4.2 could leave the helper missing, breaking the installation.
- Fix: crash on exit when closing the app.
- Fix: the installer no longer deletes unrelated files in a custom installation directory.
- Binaries compiled with Flutter 3.47.8.
